escena: SCENE photographed in the Efeonce digital studio, hard neutral daylight raking in from a low window at frame left, physically motivated light with crisp small shadows, no amber cast, modern digital tools. The upper 38 percent is an unbroken smooth graphite plaster wall in deep shadow for white advertising typography to be composed later, no beams, objects or figures in that area. All action is concentrated between 42 and 78 percent of frame height, large enough to understand on a phone. Only one small Codex figure, exact proportions and silhouette of its reference, photographed as a real tactile physical 25cm object, with contact shadows. No people. No paper, no books, no coffee mugs, no company wordmarks, no fabricated logos, no legible screen text. Blue comes from the navy equipment and the figurine, orange is a single physical functional detail, never a global filter. No holograms. Precise real optical texture, sophisticated commercial photography, not CGI. A modern large machined-aluminium inspection lens on a low stand dominates the lower centre of the picture. THROUGH the lens we see a magnified small section of an illuminated tablet with clean abstract blue-white lines and a clearly empty rectangular gap, no readable characters. The Codex figure stands beside the instrument, one little hand resting on the stand as if adjusting it, face unobstructed by glass. A single orange adjustment collar provides the story accent. Navy anodised digital workbench and one short braided cable, no extra decor. The lens makes a real physical optical distortion of the tablet, never duplicates the figure. Low 100mm macro perspective f/4; the large round lens is hero and Codex is secondary. The tablet stand is anodised active blue #0375DB metal, clearly visible as a functional blue object independently of the mascot, never a background panel. The figure is turning the adjustment collar at the instant the lines in the lens come into focus.
instrumento: the broad circular glass of a modern machined aluminium inspection lens on a low stand above the tablet
